itens.t: US voters head to polls for high-stakes midterm elections

The crucial vote will determine the balance of power in Congress during the second half of his term, with all 435 seats in the House of Representatives and 35 Senate seats up for grabs.

Republicans currently hold a slim majority in the Senate and control the House, while Democrats need to flip a small number of seats to gain control of either chamber. In addition to federal races, voters will decide gubernatorial contests in 36 states alongside various local legislative battles and state ballot measures.

itens.t: JWST uncovers unique ice and dust composition of interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS

While different from solar system comets, these ice grains share striking similarities with icy trans-Neptunian objects located at the edge of the solar system beyond Neptune.

Discovered entering the solar system in the summer of 2025, 3I/ATLAS is only the third interstellar object detected from the Milky Way. Researchers believe the comet formed within a planet-forming disk around a young star perhaps 10 to 12 billion years ago.
